catch_copy: An all-new Science Fiction action adventure with its own unique hacking twist!
description: PRAGMATA—An original IP from Capcom. It is the near future, and protagonists Hugh and his android companion Diana, must work together as they make their way through the cold lunar research station.
network_feature_description:
This software supports the following:
- amiibo
- Surround sound (linear PCM)

The following features are supported for compatible TVs:
- HDR output

notices.text:
PRAGMATA Sketchbook - DEMO:
The gameplay demo, Sketchbook, lets you try out this combat system that engages both sides of your brain, while you also get to experience what it's like to traverse the lunar research station.

*This demo supports English and Japanese voice.
*Some in-game features may differ from the full game.

Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared your warm messages of feedback and support. In order to bring the game to you as soon as possible, we've moved the release date on Nintendo Switch™ 2 forward in most regions from Friday, 24 April 2026 to Friday, 17 April 2026.

As a result of the release date change, pre-orders of the Nintendo Switch 2 digital version in the EMEA region will be automatically cancelled, and you will need to place a new pre-order on Nintendo eShop. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

To ensure that no one misses out on the digital pre-order bonus as a consequence of the above change, we are pleased to confirm that this content will now be an early purchase bonus available past the original release date until Thursday, 14 May 2026, 23:59 (local time).
 
Notes:
- The release date for the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Pragmata in Japan and Asia remains unchanged at Friday, 24 April 2026.
 - The release date for the Diana amiibo™ in Australia and North America has been changed to Friday, 17 April 2026.


Early Bird Bonus:
・Hugh Outfit - Neo Bushido
・Diana Outfit - Neo Kunoichi

Play as Hugh and Diana in samurai and ninja inspired costumes from the Sengoku Period.

The above content may also become available at a later date.

strong_disclaimer: *This product is also available as part of a set. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.
